summary: This note is a Wikipedia-style entry on Pam Ewing, a fictional character on the CBS primetime soap opera Dallas. It covers her debut in the 1978 premiere, her portrayal by Victoria Principal and later Margaret Michaels, her 1987 car crash storyline, and her early conflicts with the Ewing family over her Barnes background. It also notes her enduring love for Bobby Ewing, compared to Romeo and Juliet.
one_line: Pam Ewing is a fictional character on the CBS soap opera Dallas, played by Victoria Principal, married into the Ewing oil family.
key_facts: Pamela Barnes Ewing is a fictional character from the CBS primetime soap opera Dallas.
Victoria Principal portrayed Pam Ewing on Dallas.
Pam Ewing first appeared in the first episode, titled "Digger's Daughter", which was first broadcast on April 2, 1978.
Dallas follows the trials of the wealthy Ewing oil family in Dallas, Texas.
Principal played Pam until the end of the tenth season of Dallas in 1987.
In 1987 Pam crashes into a truck carrying butane and propane and her body is severely burned.
Margaret Michaels briefly played Pam in an attempt to write the character out.
Pam's season 1 storylines focus on her relationship with her husband Bobby Ewing, played by Patrick Duffy.
Pam faces considerable suspicion and hostility from within the Ewing family because she is a member of the Barnes family.
Pam's love for Bobby remains a strong character trait throughout her tenure on the show.
Pam and Bobby's relationship is noted for its similarities to Romeo and Juliet, with two people from hostile families falling in love.
